description.value: Pho V. Ta is a Vietnamese restaurant in Nanaimo serving authentic pho, vermicelli bowls, rice dishes, and Vietnamese crepes, all made with zero MSG. The menu spans a wide range of traditional dishes from beef noodle soups to grilled lemongrass proteins, with a dedicated vegetarian section. Touring cyclists heading through Nanaimo can fuel up with a hot bowl of pho or grab takeout to continue their ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms an active, sit-down Vietnamese restaurant at 1-1601 Bowen Rd, Nanaimo. The about-us page explicitly states takeout is offered, and the menu navigation includes a 'Vegetarian dishes' category, confirming plant-based options. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
